agent_teams_add_member.description: Add a member to the team roster. Planning and idle roster rows do not call a model. After approval, the member session starts with its first ready task or explicit message and remains durable for later work.

executionPrompt.description: Optional member-specific execution prompt. It remains editable while staged.

model.description: Optional model override. Omit for the captain's current model (or the configured memberModel default).

name.description: Unique member name inside the team.

provider.description: Optional LLM provider route. Use only when the user explicitly requests a different provider; requires model.

reasoning_effort.description: Optional reasoning effort override: one of the target model's supported effort ids, or "default" to force its default. When omitted, the captain's effort is inherited only for the same provider/model; a changed route uses the target default.

role.description: Role of the member (e.g. researcher, engineer, reviewer).

agent_teams_amend_task.description: Captain-only controlled contract amendment for one non-terminal quality task: replace a wrong objective/acceptance/verify/inScope/outOfScope when the original contract makes honest completion impossible (for example a verify command that cannot pass, or an inScope that forbids the file the objective names). The amendment is appended to the task's revisions ledger with previous values and the reason, and is rejected once a review/requirements task has passed judgment on this task. Members cannot amend contracts; the implementer re-reads the amended contract before its next quality gate. Lists are full replacements, not deltas.

acceptance.description: Replacement acceptance criteria (full list, not a delta).

reason.description: Why the current contract is wrong; recorded in the revisions ledger.

task_id.description: Task whose contract is being amended.

verify.description: Replacement verification commands (full list, not a delta).

agent_teams_approve.description: Approve and start a staged team plan. Call this only in response to an explicit user approval in a new user turn; never call it during the turn that created or edited the plan. The Web Approve & Run button uses the same runtime directly.

agent_teams_claim_task.description: Members claim their own ready task or read their existing attempt_id. Captains must use reassign_task to assign and wake a member; claim_task does not dispatch work. A member cannot own a second unfinished task. The returned attempt_id is required for updates and becomes stale after retry/reassignment.

assignee.description: Deprecated: claim_task only supports a member claiming its own task. Captains must use reassign_task.

agent_teams_create.description: Create a team. Use approval=required for a two-phase plan: members and tasks remain unspawned/unclaimed until the user reviews the Web plan and explicitly approves it. Optional profiles expand their configured roster; seed profiles also expand template tasks, while captain profiles leave the graph for the Captain to design. approval=automatic preserves the legacy immediate-execution path.

approval.description: required stages the plan for explicit user review; automatic starts immediately. Defaults to automatic for API compatibility.

description.description: Team purpose / the goal the team will work on.

name.description: Name for the new team (used as its stable id).

plan.description: Optional complete ordinary-work roster and DAG in one atomic call, instead of separate add_member/create_task rounds. Mutually exclusive with profile. For quality gates use create_task with the explicit quality contract.

executionPrompt.description: Member-specific execution prompt. It remains editable while staged.

quality.description: Quality mode: generate the standard DAG instead of writing five tasks by hand. Mutually exclusive with tasks.

inScope.description: REQUIRED: replaces the generator placeholder. Derive from the real workspace.

verify.description: REQUIRED: replaces the generator placeholder. Use commands that actually exist in this repo.

id.description: Local reference used by dependencies in this plan; the result maps it to a durable task id.

kind.description: Quality kind. Omit for ordinary work. A quality kind requires objective + acceptance (plus inScope + verify for implementation/repair/integration).

model.description: The model that runs THIS task. Recorded on the task record so the result keeps a single, answerable attribution.

reviewedTaskId.description: For kind=review: the seed task id (from this plan) being reviewed.

agent_teams_create_task.description: Create a task in your team's task list. Use kind=work (default) for research, repository audits and general tasks. kind=review is only a quality gate for an existing implementation/repair task via reviewedTaskId. Every call must include a non-empty subject, including verification and review tasks. Tasks can depend on other tasks (dependencies): a task is only claimable once every dependency is completed. Optionally assign it to a member, who still claims it before working.

acceptance.description: Acceptance criteria. Required for quality kinds.

assignee.description: Member name when an owner is specified. Omission puts this task in the shared pool; roles, subjects and descriptions do not assign an owner.

bindModelReasoningEffort.description: Optional reasoning effort for the rebind requested by bindModelTo.

bindModelTo.description: Rebind the model of an EXISTING task id. Fail-closed: refused once that task has executed (attempt > 0, claimed/in_progress, or settled).

coverageOf.description: User-constraint / goal items this task covers.

dependencies.description: Task ids this task depends on (must be completed before this task can be claimed).

description.description: What needs to be done, in detail.

inScope.description: Workspace-relative POSIX paths this task may change.

kind.description: Explicit task kind. Omission means work with no quality gates, even if the subject says implementation/review. Quality kinds require a contract. An implementation may be planned before requirements passes when its dependency chain includes that requirements task.

model.description: The model that runs THIS task. Recorded on the task record so the result keeps a single, answerable attribution even though one durable member executes many tasks across rounds. A review task may declare a different model from the implementation it judges.

objective.description: Required non-empty objective for quality kinds.

outOfScope.description: Workspace-relative POSIX paths this task must not change.

reasoning_effort.description: Optional reasoning effort for this task's model binding. Only meaningful together with model; "default" forces the target model's own default.

resume.description: If true, clear halted in the same lock before creating the task.

reviewed.description: A review stamp: {at, by, checks[]}. Optional — its absence means "not reviewed yet", which is a normal state (a task the user ruled on did not go through auto-generation).

at.description: Epoch ms when the review was stamped.

by.description: Identity that performed the review (adversarial, captain, …).

checks.description: Per-question verdicts (pass / fail / unmeasured). A bare boolean would be indistinguishable from one here.

id.description: Question id (scope, prerequisite, move, acceptance, boundary, …).

verdict.description: pass / fail / unmeasured. unmeasured must NOT be folded into pass.

why.description: Why this verdict — the reading that produced it.

reviewedTaskId.description: Existing AgentTeams implementation/repair task id. Required for kind=review; an external repository audit is kind=work.

sourceFindingIds.description: Finding ids this repair must close.

subject.description: Required non-empty title for this task. Never omit it, including for verification or review tasks.

agent_teams_declare_delivery.description: Captain-only delivery declaration: asks the delivery insertion point whether this team may be reported to the user as delivered, and REFUSES when it may not (uncovered goals, members that never converged, unfinished quality gates). Use it right before telling the user the work is done. agent_teams_status only REPORTS the same verdict without refusing, so reading team state never blocks.

workspace.description: Optional. A registered workspace path or title to read delivery state from, instead of your own workspace. An unregistered name is REJECTED (it does not silently fall back to your own workspace). Omit to keep the previous behaviour.

agent_teams_delete.description: End and archive your team: interrupts members and moves the current tasks and mailboxes out of active state for later inspection. Use when the work is done or explicitly abandoned. A same-name archive replaces its previous generation.

agent_teams_edit_plan.description: Atomically revise an AgentTeams plan. While staged, edit tasks and roster without starting work. While running, only update_task is allowed, and only for pending tasks with no prior attempt: correct dependencies, assignees or descriptions before they start; newly ready work is scheduled after commit. Never edit active/finished attempts. Submit dependent edits in order. Never modify .agent-teams files directly.

operations.description: One atomic, ordered batch. Running teams allow only update_task for never-started pending tasks. If any operation is invalid, none of the edits are saved.

acceptance.description: Acceptance criteria. Required for quality kinds.

assignee.description: Optional task assignee; an empty string moves it to the shared pool.

dependencies.description: Complete replacement dependency list for a task.

inScope.description: Workspace-relative POSIX paths this task may change. Required for implementation/repair.

kind.description: Required for add_task: the task kind must be declared explicitly — this route must not silently create a "work" task. A quality kind additionally requires objective + acceptance; implementation/repair also require inScope + verify.

member_name.description: Member name for update_member or remove_member.

model.description: Optional member model; defaults to the current staged route.

objective.description: Required non-empty objective for quality kinds.

provider.description: Optional member provider; defaults to the current staged route.

subject.description: Required for add_task; optional replacement for update_task.

task_id.description: Task id for update_task or remove_task.

agent_teams_reassign_task.description: Atomically retry, reassign, or let the captain take over one ready unfinished/failed task. The old attempt is revoked before its member is interrupted, so late updates cannot overwrite the new owner. Use assignee="captain" only when you will finish that task in this turn; a captain can own only one unfinished takeover at a time, and an unfinished takeover returns to the member pool when the captain becomes idle.

assignee.description: Active member name, or "captain" for captain takeover.

reason.description: Why the task is being retried or reassigned.

agent_teams_remove_member.description: Remove a member safely: revoke its current attempts, return all unfinished owned tasks to the shared pending pool, interrupt its live turn, and mark it removed.

name.description: Name of the member to remove.

agent_teams_restart.description: Captain-only: re-run this plugin's apply() so it picks up its current config. ★ This does NOT change which code the process runs: a fiber restart re-executes apply against the module already loaded in memory (no import, no cache drop), so edits built to disk stay invisible until the HOST PROCESS is restarted. The result therefore reports `code_on_disk_in_effect` — measured, not assumed: "yes" means the process already holds the build on disk, "no" names the build it actually holds, "unmeasured" means it could not be determined. Use after a gate/tool change has been built AND verified. This is an ARBITRATION, not a re-check: it does not re-run the verdict — it only asks whether a passing verdict exists and whether any task is in progress. Refuses when either precondition fails, and says which one.

verdict.description: The already-completed verdict for the code now on disk. Only "passed" is accepted; this tool deliberately does not re-run the verdict.

agent_teams_resume.description: Explicitly resume a halted team. Requires a non-empty reason. Does not recreate cancelled tasks; only still-pending work is scheduled.

reason.description: Why the team is being resumed.

agent_teams_review_plan.description: Run the adversarial plan review on a task contract and, ONLY if every question passes, return a `reviewed` stamp you can pass to create_task/amend_task. Call this before dispatch: `dispatch.plan-reviewed` rejects any task without a stamp. When the review cannot settle a question (needs-review) or rejects it, this tool returns NO stamp and lists each failing question with the remedy — a stamp whose shape is legal but whose content failed would launder "cannot decide" into "reviewed".

by.description: Who performs the review (recorded in the stamp). Defaults to the caller identity (`captain` or the member name).

contract.description: The contract to review: the same fields you are about to pass to create_task (subject, objective, inScope, outOfScope, acceptance, verify, dependencies, kind).

acceptance.description: Acceptance criteria — each must be falsifiable by one directed mutation.

dependencies.description: Task ids this contract depends on.

inScope.description: Workspace-relative POSIX paths this task may change.

kind.description: Quality kind (implementation / repair / verification / review / requirements / integration / work).

objective.description: Why this task exists — what breaks if it is not done now.

outOfScope.description: Workspace-relative POSIX paths this task must not change.

agent_teams_send_message.description: Send coordination or current-task guidance directly to the captain or a teammate. A running recipient receives it at the next model step; an idle recipient wakes. Messages are durably retained until read. Use task creation/reassignment for a new unit of work, not repeated status nudges.

from.description: Sender (defaults to the caller: the captain, or the calling member).

source_attempt_id.description: Sender execution capability paired with source_task_id. Stale reports are rejected. Omit for ordinary captain guidance.

source_task_id.description: Sender task, NOT the recipient task. Members include it with source_attempt_id. Captains sending guidance normally omit both source fields.

delivered.description: live (accepted by the live captain), wake (member recipient woken), mailbox (durable inbox only), or duplicate (same message already retained).

agent_teams_status.description: Team snapshot: members with live activity and tasks with status/assignee/dependencies/output. Captains also see every team mailbox; members see only their own inbox. Use after mailbox progress deliveries or for an explicit status request. After dispatch, end your turn while members work; do not repeatedly poll.

agent_teams_update_task.description: Update a task status/output. Members must supply the current attempt_id returned by claim_task; stale attempts are rejected after takeover/reassignment. Terminal results are immutable, but owners and the captain can append acceptanceResults/commandsRun/evidence_note as attributed supplemental evidence, without reclaiming or changing the verdict. A captain must use reassign_task(assignee="captain") before updating active member-owned work.

acceptanceResults.description: Acceptance evidence in contract order: {criterion, status:"passed"|"failed", evidence?}. Supply one item per acceptance criterion.

attempt_id.description: Members must explicitly include the current attempt_id from their assignment/claim in EVERY update, including failed reviews with findings. If omitted, retry with the same current id; omission does not revoke the attempt.

changedPaths.description: Workspace-relative POSIX paths changed by this implementation/repair.

commandsRun.description: Verification evidence in contract order: {command, status:"passed"|"failed", exitCode?, evidence?}. Supply one item per verify command.

evidence_note.description: Append-only supplementary observation on a terminal task. Does not reopen work or change the original result.

findings.description: Structured review findings. Required when verdict is needs_revision or reject; each item needs id, severity, problem, and requiredFix.

output.description: Original result summary; immutable after completion/failure.

verdict.description: Required for completing requirements/review. needs_revision and reject must fail the task.
